But what is it doing here?|audio = ContainmentWave17.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 16 ([[Containment]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Enigma''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had decent health and speed. It turned into a random enemy upon death, which could spawn with a random attribute. ==Appearance== The '''Enigma''' had a black body with a glowing pink question mark on its torso and a single pink glowing eye. It emitted black and purple mist when killed. ==Enemies Summoned== The '''Enigma''' could summon three enemies, that being the [[Hex Corpse]] with a 25% chance, [[Hex Revenant]] with a 25% chance and [[Hex Wraith]] with a 50% chance. However, each one could spawn with a random attribute, with these being: *None (18.18% chance) *[[Nimble]] (27.27% chance) *[[Bloated]] (9.09% chance) *[[Health Regen]] (18.18% chance) *[[Aggro]] (9.09% chance) *[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] (18.18% chance) ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can be quite effective against it. *The '''Enigma''' is a summoner enemy, which can summon enemies with various attributes. **It can summon [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, meaning that hidden detection or towers that can damage them indirectly are needed to deal with this. **It can summon [[Aggro]] enemies, making all your towers target them instead of the enemy they were targeting before. ***Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful in such cases. ***Units will target the [[Aggro]] enemy if they have a ranged attack, however, they can still be used to collide with enemies that are in front of it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EnigmaSpawn.gif|Unused spawning animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) EnigmaWalk.gif|Walking animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) EnigmaStun.gif|Stun animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) }} ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' -
